{{Top|leg}}
The '''TIE Bomber Mark 2''' was a proposed upgrade to the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] suggested by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] after analyzing its capabilities during the [[Hook Nebula campaign]]. Among his suggestions were greater speed and maneuverability, and a less prominent profile. The design was never realized, but [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] incorporated some of Bren's suggestions into the [[Scimitar assault bomber]].
